header.sector: Power generation, grid and interconnection for AI datacenters
header.title: Rising rates and data-center moratoriums are driving utilities sector underperformance

s01_bottom_line.text: The article argues utilities, though enablers of the AI build-out, have underperformed sharply (ending September around -10% since May) due to state data-center moratoriums and higher Treasury yields competing with their dividends.
If moratoriums expand and rates stay elevated, utilities exposed to AI power demand could see continued earnings and multiple pressure, but the article does not quantify an earnings effect.

items.text: Utilities price and P/E declined after the New York data center moratorium and dropped sharper after Texas data center restrictions in early August.
State governments have put moratoriums on data-center build-out, weighing on utilities.
Higher Treasury yields compete with utilities' dividends, weighing on the sector.
